The child has fever for 2 days. The temperature is 38.0°C. Malaria risk in this area is high. Malaria test is available and the result is positive. The child has measles cough and generalized rash. There is no mouth ulcer, no obvious cause of fever, and no identified bacterial cause. The child does not have stiff neck. There is no clouding of cornea, no red eyes, no pus draining from the eye, and no runny nose. Measles has not occurred within the last 3 months. The child has diarrhoea for 3 days and there is blood in the stool. The drinking status is normal. The child is not restless or irritable. Skin pinch is normal and the eyes are not sunken. The child does not have any danger sign: not convulsing now, no history of convulsions, not lethargic or unconscious, able to drink or breastfeed, not vomiting everything. The child has ear pain but there is no ear discharge, no pus draining from the ear, and no tender swelling behind the ear.
